title: 30A All Day Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC OR PRIVATE BEACH - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - FREE Community Amenities- Private beach access, recreational paths, tennis Courts, shuffleboard courts, corn hole, 3 pools and hot tubs - 2 King rooms with smart TVs and additional bunk nook - Washer and dryer - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants - Top floor unit, won't hear jumping above you! - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ADDITIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) 30A All Day, is a 4th floor Gulf Place condo with amazing views of the Emerald Coast. This coastal designed condo features two bedrooms, both with king-size beds and a twin bunk nook. The kitchen comes with everything you need to relax and enjoy your home away from home. You can enjoy your morning coffee or evening cocktail while you watch the sun dip into the sea on the full size balcony just off the kitchen and beautifully decorated and comfortable living room. This condo will is perfect for your family getaway. ACCOMMODATIONS: • Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite bath, TV • Bedroom 2 – 1 King, hall bath, TV • Bunk “Area” – 1 Twin/Twin bunk (sleeps 2) • Sofa Pullout in Living Room - Full BEACH ACCESS: Gulf Place has a private deeded beach access. Or, you can also use Ed Walline Public Beach Access. Sorry, no pets!
